name: Coupang, Inc.
moat_justification: Owned dawn-delivery logistics network and Wow membership habit in Korea are real and stress-tested (customers stayed through the 33M-account data breach; active customers rose to 24.7M in Q2 2026), but scale has not converted into durable margins or pricing power, Korean regulatory costs are recurring, and the moat does not yet travel — Taiwan/Farfetch consume the core's cash at a guided $950M-$1.0B FY2026 EBITDA loss.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.03 vs 3-yr median 0.31 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 9.7x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict
one_liner: Real Korean logistics moat (6/10) but owner's earnings have collapsed for three years — at $14.30 it clears nothing (weighted IRR 6.9%, IV@15% $4.45); it would need ~$4.45 to clear the 15% hurdle.
moat_for: Owned Rocket Delivery dawn/next-day logistics network rivals have not replicated in Korea
Rocket Wow membership habit — active customers rose to 24.7M through the data breach
Scale and data flywheel in a dense, high-penetration e-commerce market
Net-cash balance sheet funds expansion without dilution stress
moat_against: Naver's search-distribution share and AliExpress/Temu price attack
Structurally thin retail margins; no demonstrated pricing power
Recurring Korean regulatory fines, FTC actions and tax assessments
Developing Offerings (Taiwan, Farfetch) burn ~$1B/yr of core cash
